topic: How does the hybrid SIW-waveguide feeding topology balance efficiency and compactness in V-band satellite antenna designs?
response: The hybrid SIW-waveguide power divider balances efficiency and compactness in V-band satellite antenna designs. This topology optimizes performance by minimizing insertion loss.  Experimentation reveals a gain of 39.2 dBi with 41% efficiency at 59 GHz, while maintaining a 1-dB gain bandwidth of 8.1% within the same frequency band. This addresses the trade-off between high efficiency and compact configuration.
reference_context: This paper proposes a hybrid SIW-waveguide power divider to reduce the loss of the feeder line, enabling high efficiency and compact configuration. The antenna operates at the V-band, and experimental results show a reflection coefficient below -10 dB, a gain of 39.2 dBi, and an efficiency of 41% at 59 GHz, with a 1-dB gain bandwidth of 8.1% within the same frequency band.
